```{.r .cell-code}
library(janeaustenr)
library(ggplot2)
library(wesanderson)
library(tidyr)

sent <- sample(sentences,1)

sent
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "The small red neon lamp went out."
```


:::
:::


### How many characters?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
str_length(sent)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 33
```


:::
:::


### How many words?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
length(unlist(str_match_all(sent, "\\b\\w+\\b")))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 7
```


:::
:::


### How many words start with a vowel?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sent_split <- unlist(str_split(sent, boundary(type = "word")))

str_extract(sent_split, "^[aeiou]\\w+" )
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] NA    NA    NA    NA    NA    NA    "out"
```


:::
:::


### How many words start with a consonant?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sent_split <- unlist(str_split(sent, boundary(type = "word")))
# We only need to change one character!
str_extract(sent_split, "[^aeiou]\\w+" )
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "The"   "small" "red"   "neon"  "lamp"  "went"  NA     
```
